svg.text: · request a vote on an action
none: votes are cast and the record
is closed through the rules contract
MemberState and the app's own contracts that an action changes.
A vote or confirmation names each one by AuthenticKey and pins it with a Snapshot.
The bootstrap creates the first rules contract from the result of FoundingAgreement_Complete.
The app's request-vote choice creates a shared vote record that names its targets by key.
DecOperatorRules_CastVote archives the shared vote record and re-creates it with the vote.
The DecOperator service finds each target's current contract ID by key through KeyedTarget.
DecOperatorRules_CloseVote counts the votes, archives the record and executes the accepted action on the targets.
The app's confirm choice creates an action confirmation that names its targets by key.
The DecOperator service finds each target's current contract ID by key through KeyedTarget.
ActionConfirmationRules_Execute archives the matching confirmations and executes the action on the targets.
ActionConfirmationRules_Expire archives an expired action confirmation.
MemberState stores no member status, so its choices fetch the rules contract to check the actor.
An accepted DOA_AddMember creates the new member's MemberState.
DecOperatorRules_ActivateMember re-creates the rules contract and exercises MemberState_CompleteJoining.
